page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.2xlarge is a burstable virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.t5 family, built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include any local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff inherent to its burstable CPU allocation model. Single-core performance is limited, with stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded compression tests all scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains average for both cached and uncached operations, though the Passmark memory score and database operations fall into the bottom 25%.

Given its burstable CPU allocation and lack of local storage, this instance is designed for cost-conscious workloads with variable CPU utilization. It is well-suited for static web serving, where it achieves average throughput, and lightweight multi-threaded tasks that can tolerate variable CPU availability. It is less suitable for sustained high-performance computing, database hosting, or intensive single-threaded processing due to its low single-core performance and weak database operation benchmarks.
